title: RAG Explained: How Retrieval-Augmented Generation Works & Its Types
topic: Interactive and beginner-friendly explanation of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), its complete indexing and query pipeline, and all major RAG types (Naive, Advanced, Modular, Agentic, GraphRAG, Multimodal).

global_style.art_style: Clean hand-drawn whiteboard explainer illustration style, crisp black ink marker sketches on a bright white whiteboard background, vibrant blue, green, orange, and red marker highlights, neat hand-lettered labels and simple diagrams, friendly stick figures, boxes, and directional arrows, bright even studio lighting, 16:9 widescreen framing.
global_style.negative_prompt: dark background, photorealistic, 3D render, blurry, messy overlapping scribbles, garbled unreadable text, watermarks, low contrast

beats.narration: Quick question for you: have you ever asked an AI a very specific question, and it answered with total confidence—except every single word was completely made up?
